item.description:
### Added - **Storage, a new Settings pane for getting disk space back from git worktrees.** It lists every worktree in the repositories your agents work in, including ones you made by hand. For each one it shows its size, when it was last used, which agent made it, and what you'd lose: uncommitted files, commits that are on no branch, and commits that were never pushed. - **Move a worktree to the Trash from the Storage pane.** Perch checks first and won't move one that's locked, that a session or an open editor is using, or that holds work it can't account for. Commits that are on no branch are saved to a `perch/saved/` branch before the move. You can put it back from the Trash until you empty it. - **Clear git's leftover records** for worktrees whose folder is already gone. Each record goes to the Trash, and Perch won't clear one that still holds commits on no branch.
### Fixed - **Claude Code: a session you named shows that name** even when it runs without Perch's hooks.
